prompt: Low head-on camera tracking backward as SHARES, the dark bay on the left, and HOUSES, the grey on the right, gallop straight at the lens side by side, jockeys crouched, clods of wet turf and mud spraying from their hooves. The camera keeps them filling the frame for the whole clip. Behind them, on the right, the chestnut WAGES stays inside its shut stall, head over the gate, calmly watching them leave and growing smaller. Cloth words stay exactly as they are. Sound: thundering hooves, horses blowing hard, rain, a rising crowd roar far off, no talking. Real-looking footage of an English racecourse on a grey, wet day. Thanks.
